name: Approach road
purpose: The threshold from the outside world: a short lantern-lined causeway where the roar of the flank falls on the left and the lit torii dead ahead tell you that you have arrived.

ceiling_profile.note: Open sky. Black rock flank rises steeply on the north side (left); the south side drops to the cascade pools and the sea.

portals.note: Spawn edge (west edge of the grid); not in layout.json portals.

hero.outside_ok: The falls drop down the flank 1-2 m north of the road edge into a plunge pool; only the spray reaches the road.
hero.why: The south-branch cascade comes off the west flank right beside the road: a white, roaring, uplit sheet on the left that the road crosses on a slab bridge. It is the first water you meet and the brightest moving thing until the torii; it says 'the spring runs through everything' before you see a building.

anchored.why: Carries the road over the stream between the plunge pool (north) and the A4 falls (south). Low basalt parapets double as the road railing over the water.
Carved stone marker at the grid edge: the brand appears once, quietly, before the gate (lookbook: materials first, logo second).

water.outside_ok: Plunge pool sits just north of the road edge (y 60-63).

water.note: Proposed: runs under road_bridge (0.6 m below the deck), then leaves the road south and drops off the A4 lip (12.4, 35.5, -0.65) into g_cascade pool P1 (-2.05). Channel between runs outside all footprints along the gate court west edge: (6.5, 48) -> (10.5, 40).

sightlines.see: Torii posts lit from below, framing the warm porch of the hall 40 m east; the falls white on the left.
Looking left: the falls and its steam column uplit teal; looking right: the cascade pools glowing below.
The torii fills the frame; through it, banners and hanging lanterns on the porch.

concept.match: Plan 31's approach road at eye height: two converging rows of warm post lanterns on railings, the dark torii silhouette at the end against the lit hall front.

lights.why: Two converging rows (ground plan 31) are the eye-leading line to the torii; spacing tight because the road is short.

lights.outside_ok: In the plunge pool just north of the road edge.
lights.why: Teal-white uplight at the plunge pool so the falls read at night (hero brightest).

dressing.why: Edge over the plunge pool before the bridge.
South edge drops toward the cascade pools.
A single windswept pine where the road meets the gate court, dark against the lantern glow.

mood.key: falls on the left, torii ahead
mood.palette: blue-hour sky, amber post lanterns, white-teal falls, wet black road

waivers.reason: The falls stand 1.5 m beyond the road's north edge; the road is only 7 m wide.
